scope: The built plugin mounted through real registry methods and the real JSON Schema validator with synthetic fixtures; no live Context, server or profile.

results.name: apply registers the three readiness tools into a registry
results.observation: Three readiness tools registered; no host package import was needed.

results.name: every definition schema stays inside the host JSON Schema subset
results.observation: Host assertSupportedJsonSchema/assertObjectJsonSchema accept all parameter and output schemas.

results.name: the host validator accepts valid arguments and rejects broken ones
results.observation: Declared enums, required fields and closed nested objects all bind through the host validator.

results.name: the real registry admits the readiness tools in a resolved step
results.observation: Admission, executable lookup and model-facing schema projection all work with the plugin definitions.

results.name: a step check reports step scope and only admitted capabilities
results.observation: Step-scoped admission drives availability; the check itself runs no probe.

results.name: without a step admission the same check cannot claim availability
results.observation: No toolSet means registered-scope only, so the report stays unknown instead of optimistic.

results.name: a probe plan is inert and an approved probe verifies the capability
results.observation: Plan stays inert; run asks the host once and the recheck becomes verified.

results.name: an unsupported capability is refused at plan time with a host-valid error
results.observation: Unsupported probes never reach the host as a failed capability.

results.name: the built plugin has no runtime import outside node builtins
results.observation: Installed artifact imports only node builtins, so profile peer resolution cannot break it.
